headword: {適材|てきざい}{適所|てきしょ}
gloss: the right person in the right place

definitions.gloss: the right person in the right place; well-matched assignment
definitions.explanation: The principle of assigning each person to the role that suits their abilities. A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) used constantly in discussions of staffing and team-building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{適材|てきざい}{適所|てきしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: Personnel decisions come down to putting the right person in the right place.

examples.japanese: {適材|てきざい}{適所|てきしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The team grew stronger once everyone was placed where they fit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、{適材|てきざい}{適所|てきしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{管理職|かんりしょく}→管理職：21834_kanrishoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力量|りきりょう}→力量：18764_rikiryou⟧だ。
examples.english: A manager's ability lies not just in gathering capable people but in whether they can place each one where they belong.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {適材|てきざい}{適所|てきしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧: staffing that matches people to roles
- {適材|てきざい}{適所|てきしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to assign people where they fit
- {適材|てきざい}{適所|てきしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧: to aim for the right fit

USAGE:
Often used to praise an assignment after the fact ({適材|てきざい}{適所|てきしょ}だ) as well as to state the principle. It can also soften a reassignment: moving someone out of a role sounds better framed as {適材|てきざい}{適所|てきしょ} than as a demotion.
